title: General English
text_en: Building practical communication skills through integrated listening, speaking, reading, and writing activities.
text_id: Membangun kemampuan komunikasi praktis melalui kegiatan listening, speaking, reading, dan writing yang terintegrasi.

title: TOEFL Preparation
text_en: Developing test awareness, language accuracy, and strategic practice without losing sight of genuine language understanding.
text_id: Mengembangkan pemahaman format tes, ketepatan bahasa, dan strategi latihan tanpa mengabaikan pemahaman bahasa yang sesungguhnya.

title: IELTS Preparation
text_en: Supporting learners in strengthening productive and receptive skills for international language assessment.
text_id: Mendampingi pembelajar memperkuat keterampilan produktif dan reseptif untuk asesmen bahasa internasional.

title: English for Academic Purposes
text_en: Helping students communicate ideas, read academic texts, and participate more confidently in academic settings.
text_id: Membantu mahasiswa menyampaikan gagasan, membaca teks akademik, dan berpartisipasi lebih percaya diri dalam lingkungan akademik.
